scope: Static actual indexed GLB triangle distances and multi-layer sampled support graph. All roofs/walls/furniture/door leaves retained. Not an engine controller or camera test.
limitations: The player height and eye height are provisional, pending actual game rig/controller.

Raster and dense path samples are not an exhaustive continuous configuration-space proof. Authored stair polylines may supplement the grid only after actual support/collision checks at 5 mm spacing and validated links to both graph endpoints.
The eight-point 0.40 m support ring is conservative near unguarded edges and floor holes; a rejection due only to support coverage is not proof that every engine controller would fail.

Rounded-foot elevation is derived from contact with actual upward support triangles inside capsule radius and within .405 m adjacent-tread band. This allows a capsule to span neighboring steps without requiring its full diameter on one tread. Real centre-layer transitions remain limited to .205 m. No game controller, contact dynamics or animated doors were executed.
Source-plan fidelity, room completeness, fixture usability and visual quality require separate review.
